key_decisions.decision: Retain the threefold destruction formula and enslaved men and women; mark the difficult final clause’s alternative reading in a note.
Keep the king’s accusation distinct from the narrator’s description; preserve the face covering and ambiguous falling posture.
Retain the witness’s appeal to Mordecai’s service, the height, and the reversal of the intended victim.
